# tcpshield_domain (Data Source)

Reads a single domain of a network, by `id` or by `name` (exactly one of them).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tcpshield_domain" "play" {
  network_id = data.tcpshield_network.main.id
  name       = "play.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) Network the domain belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric domain id.
- `name` (String) Fully qualified domain name.

### Read-Only

- `bac` (Boolean) The domain's BAC switch, as shown in the TCPShield panel.
- `backend_set_id` (Number) Backend set the domain forwards to.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether TCPShield has verified the domain's DNS.
